summary: Official Workana help pages updated in October 2026 confirm that profile completion to 100% is mandatory for evaluation/moderation, that the dashboard exposes the current moderation phase (Pendiente, No aprobado, Aprobado), and that explicit approval is communicated by email. This reinforces the existing commercial gate; no proposal may be submitted until 100% completion and explicit approval are verified.
